title: Membership & Subscription Website – Build Exclusive Communities | Lovable

facts.fact: Lovable's own example prompt "Make the button gray" (updates the button styles) is listed as costing 0.50 credits.
facts.quote: “Make the button gray” | Updates the button styles | 0.50

facts.fact: Lovable's own example prompt "Remove the footer" (removes the footer component) is listed as costing 0.90 credits.
facts.quote: “Remove the footer” | Removes the footer component | 0.90

facts.fact: Lovable's own example prompt "Add authentication with sign up and login" is listed as costing 1.20 credits.
facts.quote: “Add authentication with sign up and login” | Adds authentication pages and logic, updates routes | 1.20

facts.fact: Lovable's own example prompt "Build me a landing page, use images" (3 generated images, theme, 5 sections) is listed as costing 1.70 credits.
facts.quote: “Build me a landing page, use images” | Creates a landing page with 3 generated images, theme, and 5 sections | 1.70

facts.fact: In Plan Mode, Lovable states that building costs 1 credit per message.
In Default Mode, Lovable states that the credit cost of building varies based on task complexity rather than being a fixed amount.
facts.quote: **Default Mode:** credits vary based on task complexity

facts.fact: Lovable states that Pro and Business subscriptions include credit grants for building and hosting with Cloud, in addition to the credit balance.
facts.quote: In addition to your credit balance, Pro and Business subscriptions include grants for building and hosting with Cloud.

facts.fact: Lovable states that the value of a credit and its consumption rate depend on the subscription plan and feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across plans.
facts.quote: The value of a credit and the rate at which they are consumed for a given action depend on your subscription plan and the feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across different plans.

facts.fact: Lovable states that free users can start public projects with a limited number of AI credits, while paid users can create private projects and receive more AI credits.
facts.quote: Free users can start public projects, and have a limited number of AI credits. Paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.

facts.fact: Lovable states that most membership site projects can be built in minutes to hours, depending on complexity.
facts.quote: Most projects can be built in minutes to hours, depending on complexity.
